periganglionic.definition:
a. Surrounding a ganglion; as, the periganglionic
   glands of the frog.

perigastric.definition:
a. Surrounding the stomach; -- applied to the body cavity
   of Bryozoa and various other Invertebrata.

perigastritis.translation: [医] 胃周炎, 胃腹膜炎

perigee.definition: n. periapsis in Earth orbit; the point in its orbit where a satellite is nearest to the Earth

perigon.translation: n. 周角, 三百六十度角

perigonal.definition: a of or relating to a perigone

perigone.definition: n collective term for the outer parts of a flower consisting of the calyx and corolla and enclosing the stamens and pistils

perigonium.translation: 雄器苞, 围生殖囊; 花被

perigordian.translation:
a. (欧洲旧石器时代晚期)佩里戈尔文化的 
n. 佩里戈尔文化

perigraph.definition: n. A careless or inaccurate delineation of anything.

perigynium.definition:
n. Some unusual appendage about the pistil, as the
   bottle-shaped body in the sedges, and the bristles or scales in some
   other genera of the Sedge family, or Cyperaceae.

perigynous.definition:
a. Having the ovary free, but the petals and stamens borne
   on the calyx; -- said of flower such as that of the cherry or peach.
